shortDescription: Manage BIG-IP system ASM advanced settings

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the setting on the system. When C(present), guarantees that an existing setting is set to C(value). When C(reset), sets the setting back to the default value. At least one of value and state C(reset) are required.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to set the key to. At least one of value and state C(reset) are required.
